item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Rachna studies the diagram of triangles $DEF$ and $LMN$. Matching tick marks show $DE = LM$, $EF = MN$, and $FD = NL$.

Which claim correctly decides congruence from those side lengths?

options.A: The three matching side lengths are enough: triangles $DEF$ and $LMN$ are congruent by SSS.
options.B: The triangles are congruent because each figure is called a triangle.
options.C: Congruence here also needs a right angle and hypotenuse before the side lengths can be used.
options.D: Matching side lengths are what the congruence statement creates after the triangles are already named congruent.
